verified_facts: jev-1.14.0 is listed as an explicit versioned System One model ID (distinct from floating alias jev-latest).
Served via POST /v1/systemone; accepts text/JSON object/array state; 64k per-request / 32k per-question context; billed on input tokens (output tokens free per docs).

official_documentation_urls.topic: System One HTTPS Endpoint & Request/Response Schema
verified_facts: Canonical endpoint is POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone with Authorization: Bearer <token> and Content-Type: application/json.
Request body top-level fields: model, state, questions.
Response body top-level fields: model, answers, usage (input_tokens, output_tokens).
Choice question uses type='choice', instructions, and criteria mapping option labels to descriptions.
Choice answer returns type='choice', choice (winning option label), probabilities (full distribution over all declared options summing to 1.0), and confidence in [0, 1].

Standard HTTP error codes: 400 (Bad Request / max_tokens_exceeded / non-finite numbers), 401 (Unauthorized), 413 (Payload Too Large > 32 MiB), 415 (Unsupported Media Type), 422 (Unprocessable Entity), 429 (Too Many Requests), 529 (Overloaded).

implementation_alignment.official_spec: Explicit model='jev-1.14.0' in request; response echoes 'model'
implementation_alignment.current_implementation: geometry_jev_protocol.py::GP6_MODEL='jev-1.14.0'; transport.py checks body['model']==config['model']; selector.py::parse_response requires payload.get('model')==config['model'] and records both requested_model and served_model

packaging_runtime.py::build_context builds {'model': config['model'], 'state': state, 'questions': {'next_action': {'type': 'choice', 'instructions': QUESTION, 'criteria': criteria}}}; transport.py enforces exact top-level keys {'model', 'state', 'questions'} and max_request_bytes=96000

implementation_alignment.official_spec: answers.<qid> = {type: 'choice', choice, probabilities: {<label>: float}, confidence: float in [0,1]}; probabilities sum to 1.0
implementation_alignment.current_implementation: selector.py::parse_response checks strict_json (no duplicate keys/NaN/Inf), exact answers keys {'next_action'}, exact answer keys {'type','choice','probabilities','confidence'}, choice in labels, probabilities keys == set(labels), all values finite in [0,1], probability_sum_valid (tolerance 1e-5 or strict_or_2dp_rounding_interval_v1), and choice achieves max probability within tolerance

implementation_alignment.official_spec: usage: {input_tokens: int, output_tokens: int}; docs note output tokens free / input-token billing
implementation_alignment.current_implementation: selector.py::parse_response validates usage is None or exact dict {'input_tokens', 'output_tokens'} with non-negative ints; geometry_jev_execution.py records usage_status (AVAILABLE/UNKNOWN/NA_NO_SERVICE_CALL) and keeps service_cost_usd='UNKNOWN' for real sends (doc list price never substituted for actual invoice)

implementation_alignment.official_spec: 4xx/5xx/429/529 HTTP errors; docs suggest backoff on 429/529
implementation_alignment.current_implementation: transport.py maps HTTPError to PROVIDER_FAILURE (does not persist error body to avoid credential echo) and socket/URL/timeout errors to UNKNOWN_IN_FLIGHT; max_retries=0 (no implicit retry per GP6/AGENTS contract); request ledger retains send reservation on failure and UNKNOWN_SEND

items_remaining_to_confirm.item: Exact response key strictness in live jev-1.14.0 responses
items_remaining_to_confirm.detail: parse_response enforces exact key sets on answer ({'type','choice','probabilities','confidence'}) and usage ({'input_tokens','output_tokens'}). If the live API ever adds new optional fields inside answers.next_action or usage, parse_response will classify the response as invalid_response and halt the batch safely (no silent acceptance). Live response shape can only be observed during an authorized real run.

Public docs illustrate string descriptions in criteria, while packaging_runtime.py sends structured JSON objects per Cxx option (previously accepted in JN1/JN3/JN4/JM1 real jev-1.14.0 runs). Current doc check does not prove live server acceptance without a real call.
